title: Make sure every Claude puts {A} in the plugin: a rule, a guard, a minigame action
body:
After #72, the new pattern for what {A} does was only described in `src/game/CLAUDE.md`, which Claude loads only once it opens a file there. The root `CLAUDE.md` and the old crow/chicken/Ham branches still pointed at App.tsx. This makes sure any Claude, Mike's included, follows the new pattern:

- **Root `CLAUDE.md`**, which every session loads: convention 7. What {A} does goes in the plugin's `act()`, never a new branch in App's `onInteract`. The crow, chicken and Ham are still there only until they're moved, so don't copy them.
- **`src/game/CLAUDE.md`** no longer says App handles `onInteract`.
- **Guard: `src/game/onInteract.test.ts`** fails CI on any new branch in `onInteract`. Its message spells out how to do it instead, with examples (ponies for a simple dialog, Luna Park for choices leading to a ride). Tried with a branch added on purpose; it fails with those steps.
- **A `minigame` action** whose `then` gets the score, so a character with its own game (like the chicken's Cone Catch) can be written the new way too. Before this there'd have been no allowed way to write one.

@exit320-stack: heads-up. If your Claude ever adds a character the old way, CI will stop it and say how to do it right.
